claims.quote: Mesonoemacheilus guentheri is a loach from the Western Ghats of southern India, described from the Nilgiri Hills and since recorded in Kerala.
All of them occur along the Western Ghats, a mountain chain along the west coast of India, the so called Malabar coast.

regions.name: Cardamom Hills
regions.quote: It's now known to have an extended range and has been recorded in the Periyar Tiger Reserve of the Cardamom Hills, Kerala, some distance further south.

regions.name: Panniyar
regions.quote: In the Panniyar river basin, Kerala it was collected alongside Haludaria fasciata, Tor khudree, Opsarius bakeri, Devario aequipinnatus, Rasbora daniconius, Garra mcclellandi, Homaloptera santhamparaiensis, the congener Mesonoemacheilus triangularis, and a Glyptothorax sp. during one study.
